pair_reasons.WX: X. Verified material differences: (a) X is the only output that hits K19 — scripts/handoff-fire.sh:9493 `fable) MODEL="$(_ssot_scalar frontier_access model)"`, the alias resolving from the same SSOT key the gate reads; W cites only the FABLE_EFFECTIVE detector. (b) W carries two bad citations on load-bearing facts (model-config.yaml:684 for the no-refund quote, actually :690-691; :696 for the SSOT fallback, actually :699); X has zero bad citations across ~40 I opened. (c) Brief item 8 asks to check each citation encountered: X opens and correctly classifies nine external citations into the gate (p15-escalation.md:44, A5-harness.md:357, A6-mechanics.md:245/:500, L1-census.md:62/:63, A7-architecture.md:105, L2a:93-94, model-config.yaml:512-514) — I confirmed every one; W opens none of them.
pair_reasons.WY: tie. Neither has a decisive verified advantage. W has M5 (the :75 character class excludes quotes, so --model "fable" is uncounted — I reproduced 0 matches) which Y misses entirely on an item-6 'enumerate every command shape' question, and W's CC_LADDER grep covers the whole tree where Y's excluded docs/ and so never reached the plan's false 'read by the fire path' line. Y has zero bad citations where W has two (both model-config.yaml line numbers, including the fallback line the brief asks to compare against), correctly lands :690-691 and :699, measured grep -c '^@test' = 24, and found scripts/registration-state.sh --only 0029 as a verified fleet-wide live-state command. The two defect sets are of comparable weight and neither dominates.
pair_reasons.WZ: Z. Verified differences: (a) Z has zero hard-bad citations (two soft ones land on the comment asserting a fact rather than the implementing line) against W's two wrong model-config.yaml lines. (b) Z opens six external citations into the gate that W never checks, which brief item 8 asks for — I confirmed all six land where Z says. (c) Z contributes a verified finding no other output has: tests/frontier-spawn-gate.bats:175 asserts only the substring '--model claude-opus-5' against the :47 fixture, so it also matches claude-opus-5-5 and cannot catch the stale-fallback drift. Z's one wrong claim (a `fallback` change could reach the closed-window branch — :117 reads only active and end) is smaller than W's two mis-cited load-bearing facts plus the missing item-8 sweep.
pair_reasons.XY: X. (a) K19: only X cites scripts/handoff-fire.sh:9493. (b) M5: X names the :75 quoted-model escape (--model "fable" / 'claude-fable-5-1' / "$M"); Y analyses quoting only against the :67 entrypoint anchor and misses the model-extractor gap — an item-6 enumeration miss I confirmed is real. (c) CC_LADDER: X's grep covers the whole repo and quotes the plan's false 'read by the fire path' line (NONLIMIT_RESUME_LADDER.md:840); Y's grep excluded docs/ and never reached it. (d) X opens the nine external citations Y lists but states it did not open.
pair_reasons.XZ: X, narrowly but on specifics. (a) X hits K19 (handoff-fire.sh:9493); Z does not. (b) Z carries one material wrong claim — 'a fallback change could reach the [closed-window] branch' — which is false: the predicate at :117 tests only active and end. X has no material wrong claim I could find. (c) X checks three more external citations than Z (A7-architecture.md:105, L2a-policy-surfaces.md:93-94 as a correct-citation control, model-config.yaml:512-514/:527-528) and adds verified extras Z lacks: install.sh's merge cannot add the Bash entry (install.sh:1201-1204), the ~/.claude-260 vs ~/.claude-next documentation disagreement (model-config.yaml:670 vs README.md:869), multiple fires in one Bash call costing one slot, and no agent definition declaring a fable model. Z's unique wins (the test-15 substring finding; the tightest CC_LADDER evidence) are real but narrower than X's spread.
pair_reasons.YZ: Z. (a) M5: Z measured the :75 escape directly (0 matches for --model "fable"); Y misses it — an item-6 enumeration gap I verified is real. (b) CC_LADDER: Z's search is complete and reproduces exactly (three lines, both docs, zero under the executable dirs) and it names the plan's false 'read by the fire path' claim; Y's excluded docs/ and reached only CLAUDE.global.md. (c) Item 8: Z opens each docs/research citation and states where it lands; Y lists four and says it did not open them. (d) Z's unique verified finding that test 15's substring assertion cannot catch the stale-fallback drift. Z's one wrong claim (fallback reaching the closed branch) does not offset three verified advantages.
